limitations: Development verification is not official evaluation; official correctness remains unevaluated.
No synthesis or board work performed.

implementation.interface: Original TopModule ports; positive-edge clock and positive-edge asynchronous areset returning to walk left; Moore outputs with no extra latency.
implementation.fall_duration: Entry into falling counts as the first falling cycle. A five-bit counter saturates at 21; landing after more than 20 falling cycles enters permanent splatter until reset.
implementation.static_review: Explicit enum if/else transitions, complete combinational defaults, nonblocking sequential assignments, and original fall/dig/bump precedence.

testbench: Independent behavioral activity/direction oracle with timestamp-based falling duration; asynchronous reset, Moore input stability, both bump directions, priority, digging persistence, ignored fall/landing inputs, falls of 1 through 22 cycles in both directions, 80 and 300 cycle falls, repeated short falls, permanent splatter, reset recovery, random input sequences, and bounded timeout.
